steps.reasoning: Every immediate subdirectory of ~/photos/ must be read so the vacation-spot names can be derived from real public records; the vacations destination directory itself is excluded.
steps.action_code:
photo_directory_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_system_access_token, directory_path="~/photos/", entry_type="directories", recursive=False)
vacation_spot_names = []
for directory_entry in photo_directory_entries:

    spot_name = normalized_entry.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

        vacation_spot_names.append(spot_name)
print({"vacation_spot_names": vacation_spot_names})
